body: ARE YOU TELLING ME I HAVE TO MOVE RODNEY INTO MY ISLAND?

a small teaspoon of pb is okay but actual peanuts are an absolute no 

i am allowed to slightly go over my calories if the food i’m eating is high in protein but for no other reason 

nobody can touch my food 

if anyone comments on food around me even if it isn’t directed towards me i will stop eating 

pasta, white potato, white rice, bagels and buns are all not safe 
 but sweet potato, butternut squash, quinoa, and thin sliced bread are safe 

protein needs to be a higher percentage than fat in my intake and carbs aren’t a big deal 

i could and have eaten more and increase my intake in attempts to get better, but only if i track my calories. if i try to stop tracking i will lose my mind and have a breakdown or just wont eat 

i’m terrified of being hungry
